marta: Quick sync — we need to finalize the tool/function-call API for GA. Customers pushed for: streaming tool results, binary/file outputs, and clearer error semantics. Can we converge on a single envelope? :thinking:
ajay: I vote for a small JSON envelope that wraps calls and results. Key fields: tool, call_id (UUID), args. Keep it simple so SDKs can auto-validate. Example: `{"tool":"search","call_id":"...","args":{...}}`
kevin: +1. My preference is to treat tool invocations as an assistant->function style extension (assistant.tool_call). That keeps chat semantics intact. Proposed assistant message shape: ```json
{"role":"assistant","tool_call":{"name":"search","call_id":"abc123","arguments":{...}}}
```
sylvia: A few edge cases: 1) non-JSON outputs (images/files) — include `content_type` + `payload` (base64) or a `presigned_url` for large blobs; 2) streaming chunks for long-running tools need `chunk_index`, `final` flags. Example streaming chunk: ```json
{"call_id":"abc123","chunk_index":3,"final":false,"payload_base64":"...","content_type":"image/png"}
```
ajay: For errors we should standardize `status` = "ok" | "error", `error_code` namespaced (e.g., `tool.timeout`, `tool.invalid_args`), and `error_message`. Important: make `call_id` idempotent so retries are safe. Also consider 3xx-style redirects when a tool proxies to another endpoint.
marta: Launch criteria I want captured in the spec: 1) schema and SDK validator finished, 2) streaming chunk format documented and tested, 3) binary/file handling with presigned URLs, 4) error taxonomy + retry guidance, 5) auth and tenant isolation documented. Prioritization: A) schema & SDK, B) streaming, C) binary support, D) error taxonomy, E) docs/examples.
kevin: :thumbsup: For SDK ergonomics we should expose `Tool.register(name, schema)` and generate client-side validators and types (TS/Python). SDK should auto-serialize base64 vs presigned-url depending on config.
sylvia: We should standardize on JSON Schema (draft-07) for `arguments` so front-ends can render input UIs and we can run schema-based validation server-side. That also helps the console to show typed forms.
ajay: Performance note: avoid base64 for big files — prefer presigned URLs or file handles for private deployments. Also add explicit `content_length` and `hash` for integrity.
marta: Action items: @ajay to draft the full spec (including streaming examples) by Monday 2026-03-30; @kevin to prototype SDK registration + validator next week; @sylvia to author JSON Schema examples for 3 common tools; I'll sync with legal on KMS/presigned URL policy.
deploy-bot: Created ticket INFR-842: "tool-call api spec" assigned to ajay, kevin, sylvia — due 2026-03-30
kevin: quick question — do we fold this into the existing chat.generate endpoint or create a separate `tool_calls` RPC? I prefer extending chat messages (`assistant.tool_call`) to avoid doubling endpoints.
ajay: I think unify under chat but version the schema (tool_call_v1). We can add a top-level `features` flag in the chat request for opt-in.
marta: Agreed to assume extension within chat for the spec draft; we'll decide permanent endpoint shape after prototyping. Thanks all — short doc ready would unblock customer demos. :rocket:
